redclaw_taunts: Fire the guns! That flag won't last till dawn!
Sloops first, toad. Soften those ramparts!
My fleet owns this harbor tonight!
Strike the banner! Leave them in the dark!
Rocket ship inbound. Duck, old soldier!
I am Admiral Redclaw. Your fort is toast!
flag_hit: Harold: Hold the line! The flag's still up!
Mavis: They clipped the starry banner, hon!
Harold: Dawn's coming. Keep that cloth flying!
Mavis: One more hit and we're singing goodbye!
win: The fleet broke. Flag still proud at dawn.
Redclaw's flagship limps off. Fort stands!
We held the ramparts. Breakfast is earned.
lose: The banner fell. Harbor goes dark.
Redclaw's fleet sails in. Fort lost.
No dawn for us. Reload and try again.

vic_taunts: Feel that bass in your bones, grandpa!
Voltage Vic don't miss a beat. You do!
Club night never ends at the Power Plant!
Eel juice in the wires. Dance or fry!
Your cane can't keep this tempo, toad!
Hit the pads or hit the exit, seniors!
vic_hurt: Hey! That was off-beat and rude!
win: Lights out, Vic. We owned the drop.
Perfect night. Plant goes quiet.
Harold and Mavis, club champions.
lose: Too many misses. Vic keeps the deck.
Rhythm wiped us. Try another set.
Bass dropped. We dropped with it.

homer: That one's swimming in the harbor!
out: Whiffed it. Keep your eye, hon.
Bobby got you. Shake it off.
bobby_taunts: Ten dingers before ten outs. Clock's ticking!
I'm Bird Brain Bobby. Your pitcher and judge!
No logo on this cap, just heat!
Swing soft and I'll nest on your cane!
win: Ten out of the park. Bobby tips his cap.
Derby's ours. Lights stay on.
Harold and Mavis, home run royalty.
lose: Ten outs. Bobby wins the night.
Short of ten. Back to the on-deck circle.
Bird brain 1, toads 0. Rematch?

al_taunts: Arabber Al don't stop for red lights, toad!
Produce flying! Dodge or wear the peach!
Three rams and I'm scrap. Good luck!
Cobblestones love my wheels. Hate yours!
Cart's souped up. Your cane ain't!
Fresh fruit, fresh bruises. Coming through!
win: Three rams. Al's cart tips over.
Fells Point is clear. Nice driving.
Produce everywhere. We still won.
lose: Clock ran out. Al got away.
Too much fruit, not enough rams.
Cart's gone. Chase him again.

jimmy_taunts: Big Jimmy rules the tank. Bubble up!
Claw snap! Stay off my sand!
Blue shell, bad mood. Come closer!
win: Jimmy taps out. Tank's ours.
Crab retreats. Air to spare.
Aquarium quiet. We made it.
lose: Out of air. Blackout.
Jimmy wins the deep end.
Surface next time. Rematch.

kid_taunts: Punch Out time! Mech vs cane!
Don't touch my snack bag, grandpa!
Mom said three rounds. I win all!
win: Mech pops. Kid sulks and runs.
Harborplace is ours again.
Three rounds. Brat's bagged.
lose: Down for the count. Mech wins.
Too many bag slams. Rematch?
Kid keeps the pavilion. Ugh.

duchess_taunts: Race on the harbor! I set the pace!
Ram me if you can, slow paddlers!
Dragon Boat Duchess owns this lane!
Water taxi? More like my chase course!
Foam in your face! Keep up!
First boat ride, first lesson: lose!
win: Duchess beaten. Ride continues.
Harbor lane clear. Enjoy the view.
She retreats. Paddle on, you two.
lose: She outran us. Ambush stands.
Boat's ours, race isn't. Again?
Duchess waves goodbye. Rematch.
